name: GB energy supply margins
value: No notices found; winter margin 5.9 GW
summary: No NESO or National Gas margin notices found as of 8 Nov; NESO forecasts a 5.9 GW winter margin
state: NESO's Winter Outlook of 23 Oct forecasts a 5.9 GW margin, 9.5% above peak demand, within the reliability standard, and says margin notices used in most winters do not indicate a risk to supplies. National Gas said on 23 Oct that supply capability of 592 mcm/d exceeds forecast peak demand of 493 mcm/d. Searches and NESO's Winter Watch page on 8 Nov showed no Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice.
for_you: Households and businesses are not expected to see supply interruptions on these forecasts. Tighter days are most likely during cold, still spells.
rubric_hit: Normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins (5.9 GW; gas 592 vs 493 mcm/d) and no notices were found as of 8 Nov.
basis_detail: NESO and National Gas system notices
basis_by: NESO and National Gas system notices

sources.title: NESO — British electricity supplies secure this winter despite global instability

why: When gas or electricity margins tighten, Britain risks price spikes and, at worst, controlled disconnections in winter.
drivers: Gas imports and storage, wind output, interconnectors, plant outages, cold weather.

rubric.alert: A Gas Deficit Warning, a high risk of demand control notice, or demand control used.
rubric.watch: NESO issues an Electricity Margin Notice or capacity market notice, or National Gas issues a Gas Margins Notice.
rubric.normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins; no notices issued.
